model: New randomized isomeric SMILES sequence convolution, trained from scratch per endpoint
selection: Unchanged v148: max minimum fold0/1; freeze before confirmation; no fallback
confirmation: All4 point gains>0; practical mean threshold; fold2 and valid scaffold bootstrap90 lower bounds>0

limitations: Public validation reused; historical upstream controls approximate. New method cannot guarantee official improvement.
